variant: full-episode stick reel v2 · fastrec takes, temp beds · for the showrunner's drag marks
_about: The Ep1 stick animatic v2 (ep1s-assemble, 2026-09-27). Chapters: the reel's 3 s title slate, the cold open, the finished V1 intro, the filename + disclaimer card (the 2 s card.01 beat of the old caption timeline; its text is the script's), Acts One to Three and the tag + outro placeholder (the new v2 dialogue timelines in show/reel/ep01-full/, synced flat into studio/src/reel/data/ by sync.mjs), and Act Four (show/reel/ep01-act4-v5.json with its own premix audio/reel/ep01-act4-v5/mix.wav from 3.000 s, both unchanged). Chapter and bed entries are pasted from each segment pass's handoff (show/episodes/ep01/production/stick/<seg>-notes.md §5 / manifest-part.json). Length is the script's as written: the showrunner marks the drag, then we cut. Notes: show/episodes/ep01/production/stick/assemble-v2-notes.md.
